procedure_links.title: Judge Dedee S. Costello’s procedures for scheduling a hearing and submission of orders
procedure_links.scope: Printed revision date; separate effective date not stated.

checklist.summary: After filing and service, email JA the case number, motion and requested duration; copy all parties/counsel. Coordinate a date, obtain written office confirmation, then file/serve/send the notice identifying motions and filing dates. Dates are not held; added motions require written authorization. Use Central time; scheduling impasses go to a short court conference.
Coordinate hearing dates with all parties/counsel. The reviewed document does not establish a separate general merits-conferral requirement.

When directed after a ruling, circulate the draft then email JA with all parties/counsel copied and identify form objections. Stipulated orders require written confirmation of actual review and consent; silence is not consent and requires a hearing.
Email the filed motion with the hearing request and provide the filed hearing notice after written confirmation. No general additional courtesy-copy protocol stated.

The dated manual permits telephone appearances for non-evidentiary hearings of fifteen minutes or less, with a filed/served motion and emailed motion/proposed order. Approved participants must conference together before calling the court; consult the original for connection instructions. Do not treat this dated permission as a universal remote-appearance rule.
Email Samantha Jones, copy all parties/counsel and put the clerk-assigned case number in the subject. The manual expressly supplies 850-747-5653 for questions or clarification.

PAGE 1, scheduling: After your motion has been filed and served, you must email Samantha Jones at joness@jud14.flcourts.org.
PAGE 2, time zone: All proposed hearing times will be in the Central Time Zone, and all notices of hearing must set a hearing with reference only to Central Time Zone.
PAGE 2, appearance: Telephonic appearances are permitted for fifteen minutes or less non-evidentiary hearings.
PAGE 3, contact: Samantha Jones can be reached at 850-747-5653 should you have any questions or need clarification about the procedures outlined above.
